stories.title: Expanding the human proteome with microproteins and peptideins
stories.summary: Nature, Published online: 06 May 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-10459-xA large-scale proteomics analysis of the dark proteome by the TransCODE Consortium reveals many translated non-canonical open reading frames to encode microproteins and peptideins.

stories.title: Foreshock-induced slip transients set mainshock nucleation timing
stories.summary: Nature, Published online: 06 May 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-10497-5Analysis of laboratory experiments using a rate-and-state-based Griffith-like rupture framework shows that foreshocks can regulate mainshock nucleation timing, with larger foreshocks generating higher transient sliding velocities and triggering a more rapid transition to dynamic rupture.

stories.title: Singular Bank helps bankers move fast with ChatGPT and Codex

stories.title: A Kid With a Fake Mustache Tricked an Online Age-Verification Tool
stories.summary: To stop children from bypassing its age checks, Meta is revamping its age-verification tools with an AI system that analyzes images and videos for “visual cues,” such as height and bone structure.
